name: card/testimonial-proof-card
title: Testimonial proof card
title_vi: Thẻ trích dẫn khách hàng, gạch chân nhấn
desc_vi: Thẻ nổi lên, câu trích hiện từng dòng qua mặt nạ mềm, dòng tên và chức danh hiện sau, rồi một nét gạch tay vẽ dưới cụm từ cần nhấn.
params_vi: quote: câu trích (gõ | để tự ngắt dòng) · name, role, company: người nói (role hoặc company để trống thì ẩn) · emphasis: cụm từ gạch chân · accent: màu nhấn · fg, muted, surface, border: màu · radius: bo góc · exit: none | fade | up · duration: độ dài gốc 4.5 s
notes: Motion, order and timings as in the source: card opacity 0 -> 1 and y 4cqh -> 0 over 0.5 s power3.out; each quote line yPercent 130 -> 0 with opacity 0 -> 1 over 0.6 s power3.out through its own overflow mask (padding 0.12em 0.24em 0.3em), 0.18 s stagger from 0.15 s; byline opacity + y 2.5cqh -> 0 over 0.5 s power3.out at (quote end - 0.15 s); underline: dash tween strokeDashoffset length -> 0 over 0.55 s power2.inOut at (quote end + 0.1 s), ink opacity 0 until the cue; exit fade (opacity) or up (opacity + y -6cqh), 0.45 s power2.in; the phases compress together when `duration` is too short. Sizes: all cqw / cqh / cqmin converted to px from the target box (card width min(76cqw, 150cqh), padding 6cqmin 7cqmin, quote font = 46 / sqrt(characters) cqmin clamped 3.8 to 7.2, byline sizes in cqmin). Differences: (1) line breaking: the source measured the wrapped rows in the browser (text-wrap: balance); a block cannot count on the film font being loaded while it builds, so the lines come from a balanced split on an estimated glyph width (the quote font is fitted so every line stays 6 % inside the card), or from the | characters in the quote; the emphasised words stay one unbreakable token as in the source; (2) the avatar is the initials disc of the source (the source's image slot is not ported, no photos); (3) the monospace token font of the byline and the company mark is replaced by the film's font (tracking kept); (4) accent is a hex param instead of the green / blue / violet token choice (default #71f5a7); theme tokens fg, muted, surface, border, radius are params with the source's fallback values; the source's full-box background (var(--bg)) is not painted, the film shows through; color-mix() written as hex / rgba; (5) `exit` default none and `duration` 4.5 s as in the source. Default texts are Vietnamese (source: English).
